risk: Client can execute and persist arbitrary local files as formal research input.
required_tests: API rejects bar_data_path and auxiliary_bar_data_paths with 422; resolver success and missing-binding tests

risk: Fixed JM can silently move to a newer passed file outside its Profile binding.
required_tests: Fixed JM resolves intraday_research_v1; active-binding switch does not mutate an existing task snapshot
protection_boundary: Do not change strategy parameters or actual mapping.

risk: Tasks and reports cannot be reproduced after binding changes.
required_tests: 0023 to head roundtrip; ORM column parity; task/report snapshot deep copy; report 14 no-backfill guard
protection_boundary: New columns nullable; no historical backfill or report 14 UPDATE.

risk: Queued task follows mutable path configuration without checking pinned file identity.
required_tests: Runner rejects missing snapshot file id path mismatch and changed binding while accepting original pinned snapshot
protection_boundary: Old tasks remain read-only and are not rerunnable.

risk: Lineage-free Parquet is promoted to primary/passed by defaults.
required_tests: Missing data_role and missing quality_status each fail closed
protection_boundary: Low-level fixtures must declare both fields.

risk: Inline formal result can consume warning data and has no reproducible binding.
required_tests: Warning failed partial unchecked rejected; response carries binding snapshot
protection_boundary: No warning override in formal API.

risk: Batch reports can mix independently selected assets without per-report lineage.
required_tests: Every target resolves Profile; task snapshot lists all assets; each report file id non-null
protection_boundary: Batch task primary file id may be null only when snapshot is complete.

risk: Generic resolver capability can be misused to weaken passed-only formal Backtest.
required_tests: Formal wrapper always calls allow_warning_quality=false and verifies quality_policy=passed_only
protection_boundary: Do not alter Market browser warning semantics.

risk: Formal historical scan accepts warning/unchecked data without a Profile identity.
required_tests: Warning unchecked failed partial fail closed; resolver identity roundtrip

risk: Historical scan chooses a different contract than canonical actual mapping; MKT-04 independently records the cross-consumer divergence.
required_tests: Golden actual mapping agrees across Market Signal and live target
protection_boundary: Do not modify actual mapping in Backtest task.

risk: Formal events are not traceable to an immutable market asset.
required_tests: Event persists profile_id market_data_file_id and immutable snapshot; missing lineage rejected
protection_boundary: Do not modify Signal in current Backtest implementation.

risk: Review cannot prove or reload the exact bars used by a report/trade; ADM-01 is a supporting admin example of current-state inference.
required_tests: Binding switch after report creation still loads original file and checksum
protection_boundary: Consume report lineage; do not infer from current active state.

risk: Web may silently show a guessed MAIN or provider-fallback series.
required_tests: No MAIN guess or provider drop; missing report lineage shows explicit unavailable state
protection_boundary: No changes in current Backtest implementation.

risk: Bars and indicators on one chart can originate from different binding versions.
required_tests: Concurrent binding switch preserves same file id or rejects mismatch
protection_boundary: Keep browser display available; do not fold into Backtest work.

risk: Actual contract semantics vary by consumer.
required_tests: Shared mapping golden cases and mapping lineage fields
protection_boundary: Do not change actual mapping kernel in Backtest phase.

risk: Experiment writes direct-path formal-looking task/report rows into the application DB.
required_tests: Experiment cannot call formal create_task without resolved lineage; isolated DB remains usable
protection_boundary: No production DB persistence from experiment-only paths.

risk: --use-app-db persists an unbound direct-path run despite strict physical validation.
required_tests: App DB mode rejected or requires full resolver snapshot; isolated SQLite smoke remains
protection_boundary: Preserve low-level demo without formal persistence.

risk: Formal CLI can run warning or unchecked data without a Profile binding or immutable lineage.
required_tests: CLI rejects warning failed partial and unchecked; accepts profile_id and returns immutable binding snapshot
protection_boundary: Keep check-bars browser/admin inspection separate from formal Backtest.
